findings.evidence: Read of the PR-head file: lines 39–44 are added by the diff hunk `@@ -34,6 +36,13 @@`; lines 52–55 are outside every hunk, so they are unchanged from `main`. Grep confirms both mention `ContinuousSMul A M`, `ContinuousConstSMul A N`, `hc`, and "continuity in the *scalar*". This also refutes the PR description's stated reason for the addition ("The docstring never mentioned `hc` at all") — line 54 on `main` reads "to discharge `hc`".
findings.fix: Keep only the genuinely new content — the explicit form `hc : ∀ x : M, ContinuousAt (fun a : A ↦ a • x) 0` and the fact that `ContinuousSMul A M` is its sole discharge — and fold it into the existing lines 52–55 paragraph; delete the duplicated contrast at lines 42–44.
findings.issue: The added paragraph's second half (lines 42–44: `ContinuousConstSMul A N` "cannot stand in — it is an assumption about the action on `N`, and continuity in the *module* variable at that, where `hc` quantifies over `x : M` and asks continuity in the *scalar*") duplicates the unchanged paragraph three paragraphs later (lines 52–55: "the source needs continuity in the *scalar* variable to discharge `hc`, whereas the target needs only continuity in the *module* variable, and `ContinuousConstSMul` is exactly that"). Two prose statements of the same scalar-vs-module contrast can now drift apart.

summary: Documentation-only PR adds no declarations, so there is no code duplication; but the new `hc` paragraph restates a pre-existing paragraph in the same module docstring, and the PR's justification for adding it is contradicted by that paragraph.
